description: Calculates merchant discount rate (MDR) charges on card or payment gateway sales: the MDR fee, GST on that fee, total cost, effective rate and net settlement. Uses the MDR % the user gives; it does not look up provider rates.

currency.description: ISO currency code for display, for example INR, USD or AED. Defaults to INR.

fixed_fee_per_transaction.description: Optional fixed fee per transaction, in currency units.

gst_pct.description: GST charged on the MDR fee, as a percentage.

mdr_pct.description: MDR or TDR charged by the provider, as a percentage, for example 1.8.

sales_value.description: Total value of the transactions, in currency units.

transactions.description: Optional. Number of transactions, needed only with a fixed fee per transaction.

name: mdr_charges
title: MDR charges calculator
